# Progress Reporting {-}

## Progress Reporting {-}
This WCRP was initiated in 2023. Since then, the passability of 32 structures has been assessed and the model updated to reflect the status of these structures.  

## Rehabilitated Barriers {-}
No barriers were rehabilitated through the implementation of this WCRP as of May 2026. 

## Annual Progress Report {-}
Since April 2024, the following actions were completed: 

Barrier assessments were completed for 32 structures, resulting in 13 structures confirmed as barriers and 19 structures excluded as passable or non-existent, or because there was no habitat upstream.  

The connectivity model was updated based on the above actions, and  

The first version of this WCRP was created using outputs from the updated connectivity model.
